i.x: Less than 5 hours until polls close! I’ve spent all day talking with voters in Peoria and McLean Counties, rain and wind be damned, and chatted with local journalists covering this historic election. If you’re in line by 7 PM, you can vote. Stay in line and make your voice heard!

Good morning to everyone in Illinois’ 16th Congressional District! Today is the day we can start turning things around. End this war. Stop the tariff madness. Make it easier to raise a family. Get big money out of our political system. That’s what we’re fighting for. I ask for your vote.
